name: Jellydash
description: A Jellyfin dashboard for current streams, play history, statistics, and optional notifications. This template runs Jellydash with SQLite. The mascot is based on an icon by Magnific from Flaticon.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: SQLite database, logs, and runtime files. Back up this path.

paths.name: Uploads
paths.description: Uploaded images and other user files. Back up this path.

ports.name: Web UI port
ports.description: Host port for the Jellydash web interface.

variables.name: Jellyfin URL
variables.description: Jellyfin address reachable from this container. Use a server IP or hostname, not localhost.

variables.name: Jellyfin API key
variables.description: API key from Jellyfin Dashboard, API Keys. Some statistics need an admin key.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone, for example Europe/Prague. Used for History and Statistics dates.

variables.name: Database driver
variables.description: SQLite mode for this single-container template. Leave as sqlite3.

variables.name: Database file
variables.description: SQLite file inside the Appdata mount. Leave at this path for a new install.

variables.name: Login enabled
variables.description: Set to true only after filling in both initial admin fields below.

variables.name: Initial admin user
variables.description: Initial username if login is enabled. Existing users are not changed on restart.

variables.name: Initial admin password
variables.description: Initial password if login is enabled. Change it inside Jellydash after setup.
